text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Chronicle the history of the Rose Clan into a single tome, you say...?
It is certainly a meaningful endeavor, but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the clan's history, the written records are vast.
No matter how much I compile, there is simply no end in sight...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Even so, I have to finish today's quota somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, Trainer. It took longer than anticipated.
This was one matter I could not entrust to anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a rare turn of events, Rose Kingdom
had ended up arriving late.
